title: 13 Best Herbal Tinctures For Neuritis

Examples of herbal tinctures used to treat neuritis include St. John's Wort, which is known for its anti-inflammatory properties, and Ginkgo Biloba, which improves blood flow to the nerves and reduces oxidative stress.
